In detail

Northumbria Police recorded 451 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 14.0 per 1,000 residents, the 3rd highest rate of Newcastle upon Tyne's 26 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (50), vehicle crime (8), burglary (3); the evening/night score by violent crime (29), anti social behaviour (25), public order (9). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.
